subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should Antigravity’s default menu-bar contract intentionally become Gemini-only session/weekly, replacing the existing cross-family secondary-lane semantics?
rationale: The PR makes a visible provider-policy change rather than only repairing quota ranking, and the existing descriptor/menu labels still encode the prior Claude/GPT secondary lane.

options.title: Preserve the current family contract
options.body: Keep the established Gemini and Claude/GPT lane meanings, while repairing exhausted-window selection and highest-usage consistency independently.

options.title: Adopt Gemini-only deliberately
options.body: Approve Gemini-only session/weekly as the new default only after updating descriptors, labels, migration behavior, fallback handling, and focused compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current family contract
recommendation.body: Keep the established Gemini and Claude/GPT lane meanings, while repairing exhausted-window selection and highest-usage consistency independently.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-visible default and provider-semantics decision rather than a purely mechanical implementation choice.
